data.title: lab band door 90.50.10.07xx: labs reusable by every stage

data.text:
Lab band door for 90.50.10.0701-0798. You enter the lab band here and find every lab (t432u: "The labs should be a separate page in it's own band."; band 0700-0799, t434). No work is done on this page and it drafts no passes.
Temporary: this card is written by hand because wf cannot yet print a door's type and contents. It is replaced when page 90.50.10.0407 closes passed and wf prints them from the pages. Until then, if this card and a lab's own log disagree, the lab's log is right.
What a lab is: one page that tries to break work, by another view, with one harness for its subject and one trial file per page it serves. Labs are reusable by every stage (t432u: "We want those labs to be reusable."). A lab is titled by its subject, not by a stage.
How a page uses a lab: it writes "Lab: 90.50.10.07NN" on its faces 01 and 08, and the lab writes the page under "Serves" on its faces 01 and 08. Two-way links, never matching numbers (seqAddr.md section 11). After 90.50.10.0406 lands, wf writes the links on face 08.
Before a new lab: read this list. A new lab is made only when no lab here tries that subject, or the trial needs a different harness. The pack that makes it says why.
Labs:
- 0701  wf loop lab: harness for wf end-to-end trials in tests/common/mod.rs, one trial file per page served. Serves stage 1: 90.50.10.0404, 0406, 0407, 0408, 0409, 0411, 0412, 0498. Pass 1 ready for Prima's review (90.50.10.0403 closed passed).
Room: 98 labs on 0701-0798; 0799 is the band's continuation, not a lab.
Tension: the grant none/ is a placeholder because init-page needs a grant; this page drafts no pass.
